## RubyGems

Packages are **gems**. `gem install` puts them on the system; apps should pin versions via Bundler instead.

## Bundler

`Gemfile` declares dependencies; `bundle install` resolves and writes `Gemfile.lock`. Commit the lockfile for apps. Run tools with `bundle exec`.

## Version constraints

`"~> 2.1"` allows 2.1.x but not 3.0. Prefer pessimistic constraints plus a lockfile over floating latest.

blocks.code:
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

gem "rack", "~> 3.0"
gem "puma"

group :test do
  gem "minitest"
end
